outputs.explanation: Panel A shows representative super-resolution micrographs (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) — these are micrograph/heatmap images, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual point overlay.
Panel B shows representative super-resolution micrographs analogous to panel A (localizations, density map, 3D localizations, cluster segmentation) — not a plot of averages.
Scatter plot of number of clusters per cell shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots for each cell, as stated in the caption.
Scatter plot of cluster sizes displays individual gray dots for each cluster alongside the mean ± SEM, per the caption.
Scatter plot of proportion of clustered molecules per cell shows individual gray dots for each cell along with mean ± SEM.
Panel F consists of representative micrographs/trajectory images from sptPALM, not an averaged summary plot.
Top is a histogram of diffusion coefficients (distribution of raw data, not an average) and bottom is a line plot (MSD curves per trajectory); neither plot type requires overlaid individual points.
Panel H shows trajectory images and a kymograph, which are representations of raw single-molecule tracking data, not averaged summary plots.
